Submission Instructions

  1. Prepare plain text files for three witnesses: Witness A (your adopted manuscript passage), Witness B (your partner's manuscript passage), and Base (an authoritative reference or critical edition text).
  2. Manual Collation: Create a table in Markdown manually recording all differences between Witness A and the Base text.
  3. CollateX Script: Run a Python script using collatex to collate all three witnesses, outputting an alignment table and an SVG/HTML variant graph.
  4. Inspect the CollateX output: identify any alignment missteps (e.g. transpositions treated as deletion+addition).
  5. Submit your Python script, CollateX output, and a 300–500 word analysis explaining how the variant graph structure reveals scribal habits and potential shared errors between the witnesses.
